info.title: Open Question Box API
info.description: Single recipient instance. read/write API keys authorize inbox operations; owner-only operations require a session cookie. Browser mutations using session cookies must send same-origin Origin. No CORS. Anonymous submission always requires configured anti-spam checks.

post.summary: Anonymous submission (5 attempts / 10 minutes per network)

turnstile_token.description: Required with configured Turnstile; action must be submit.

patch.summary: Answer, publish or archive (write scope). Publishing requires an answer; archive with published:false.

delete.summary: Permanently delete message and webhook copies (write scope)

post.summary: Owner login (same-origin Origin required; 10 attempts / 15 minutes)
Issue API key, secret returned only once (owner)

get.summary: Export a page (owner). Pause submissions and editing for a consistent migration.

post.summary: Import up to 500 records atomically (owner). Existing IDs skipped; profile updated. No webhook emitted.
